The Steward Who Stopped the Kill Shot — The Dark Shores — steward to Lord Darian Marsh

Status: Active — hurled the length of a hallway by a cape's wind and back through a window with a flaming pipe, unkillable and unconsulted

Darian's steward, guide, and — by his own admission — a guide who needed reminding to lead. He inventories rooms, boosts his lord into ceilings, and stopped a rolling pin mid-swing on the hunch that the man under it was not the enemy. He was right.

Evidence

  • Rapier — “The Steward Who Stopped the Kill Shot”
  • Keen Records — “When the cape's wind took him, he came back through a window with a flaming pipe and burned the tanuki leaf — a plan his own lord described, accurately, as really stupid.”
  • Mechanical Aptitude — “He inventories rooms, boosts his lord into ceilings, and stopped a rolling pin mid-swing on the hunch that the man under it was not the enemy.”

The King Who Checked the Seats — The Dark Shores (a province he rules and styles himself king of)

Status: Active — escaped the break room through the ceiling, said the word that stopped the show, and is now the only witness who has seen the Director's remote

A lord of the Dark Shores who fell out of the sky onto the Nintendo Mania pilot set with his steward and has spent two filings learning the studio's grammar: the exits lie, the applause is recorded, and the building stops when you tell it CUT. Pressed the button, took the rolling pin, ordered the V formation, crawled for the fire alarm, and hid in the alcove to watch the Director pass.
